slug: 2025-06-05 Sierra Leone reaches 93 percent national ID coverage 80 percent services digitized

systems.system: NCRA civil registration and national ID registration system
systems.tiers: National; NCRA's Deputy Director of ICT states 93 per cent civil registration and national ID coverage, that registration was previously manual and has moved to a digital system, and that over 80 per cent of NCRA services are digitised (ID4Africa 2025 AGM, reported 5 June 2025)

systems.system: Digitisation of paper-based civil registration and ID records
systems.tiers: National; about 30 per cent of historic paper records linked to current digital records, about 70 per cent still to do (reported 5 June 2025)

note: The official says registration has moved from manual to digital and 80 per cent of services are digitised, in terms of ID registration coverage; the document does not say that a birth or death is entered digitally at the office where it is declared, nor which events or offices, so no civil fact is recorded. The parent should weigh this statement: it is the nearest any slice-1 news item comes to the question.
